headline: ICJ Myanmar gen0cide ruling will strengthen South Africa case against Israel legal experts say
label: NEWS
caption:
Legal experts say a landmark World Court gen0cide ruling could impact Israel legal battle. ⚖️

The International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar committed gen0cide against the Rohingya, establishing for the first time that genocidal intent can coexist with a military objective.

South African Foreign Minister Ronald Lamola stated that the decision sets a significant precedent for South Africa ongoing gen0cide case against Israel over the war on Gaza.

Legal scholars noted the court rejected arguments that military intent erases genocidal intent, providing more legal avenues to argue that state actions in Gaza breach international obligations.

Both Myanmar and Israel have defended their armed forces as responding to insurgencies, but legal experts say the ruling creates a crucial template for future international law cases.
